method: Read OpenType name table Windows platform 3. IDs 1/2 are legacy family/style; IDs 16/17 are typographic family/style. Export uses verified ID 1. Default package preference TTF; preserve explicit valid OTF/TTF names. CSS source weights follow current web catalogue, not OS/2 numeric weight. Source ZIP entry sha256 covers the uncompressed font file; direct URL sha256 covers the response body.
reproduce: Fetch each url; when entry is present inside a ZIP, inflate that exact entry. Verify SHA-256, parse the SFNT table directory and name table, and compare Windows name records. No user workbook or document content is used.

webCssEvidence.note: Static desktop ExtraBlack OS/2 weight is 900 but its official web CSS source weight is 1000. Registry weight selects the web source face.
